rows.label: qst610202_msg0002
rows.name:
It looks hungry. Should we leave it an
offering...?

rows.label: qst610202_msg0101
rows.name:
What's a Nopon statue doing
in a place like this...?

rows.label: qst610202_msg0102
rows.name: Maybe we should leave an offering.

rows.label: qst610202_msg0201
rows.name: This is... a blessed statue, mo!

rows.label: qst610202_msg0202
rows.name: So blessed, mo... So venerable, mo.

rows.label: qst610202_msg0203
rows.name:
Grandpa said you should offer food to
a blessed statue, mo!

rows.label: qst610202_msg0301
rows.name:
This stone statue... It's incredibly
lifelike.

rows.label: qst610202_msg0302
rows.name:
Since we're here, shall we leave an
offering?

rows.label: qst610202_msg0401
rows.name:
Why is there a Nopon stone statue in a
place like this...?

rows.label: qst610202_msg0402
rows.name:
It feels totally out of place, but
somehow I really want to leave an
offering.
